notes.title: Bug fix incoming (Game crashes and fails to launch)
notes.content:
A bug where the game crashes when finishing a quest has been found. The bug will result in the game not launching correctly and will only show a black screen and play sounds.

Hotfix will be released later this week.

In the event of any bugs and crashes please refer to the previous annoincement for feedback form and bug report prodecure.

notes.title: Bottle Grannies has been released (Feedback form here)
notes.content:
The game has been released on Steam in 2 languages (english and finnish)!

In case of feedback and bug reports, please send them through here:
